snippet.title: Type Drivers | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Type Drivers!
A fast-paced multiplayer typing game where your keyboard skills fuel your car. Race solo or challenge up to 4 players online, improve your typing speed, and unlock faster cars as you progress.

⚡ Master the road by mastering the keys
⚡ Train your typing while having fun
⚡ Compete, improve, and race to victory
